item.description: ### Fixed - **The menu bar stays on one project while several sessions run.** Perch now keeps naming the same running session for at least 30 seconds instead of switching to whichever one last did something, so the label and the icons beside it stop jumping. A session that needs you still shows at once. - **Answers to OpenCode questions are delivered reliably.** Perch checks that your answer reached the agent, and a question whose agent has already gone away no longer shows up waiting for you. - Fixed a rare crash in Perch's status line helper when an agent sent an out-of-range number.
